Maya (People Ops): quick Q — midcycle promotions: if a manager submits an effective date of 2026-04-01, when will the salary show up on payroll? also what exactly goes in the manager 'evidence pack'?
Sam (Eng Manager): need this for an offer letter. does the raise honor the effective date or the next pay period? cc @Maya
Rachel (SWE II): and does title bump change refresh/grant calc immediately or at next cycle?
Alex (People Ops): short version: salary changes are processed into the next payroll run after People Ops completes the request. timeline depends on submission cutoff. e.g. if everything (leveling form + evidence + manager approval) is in by 2026-03-25 EOD we target the 4/15 paycheck for a 4/01 effective date. miss the cutoff and it shifts to the following pay period. Link to form: https://intra.redwood/leveling-form
Sam (Eng Manager): what do you need in the evidence pack?
Maya (People Ops): manager should include 3 bullets: impact, scope, and 2-3 concrete examples of recent work + peer/lead feedback. small sample template (paste into note):
```
- Business impact: led X project that improved latency by 35% across infra
- Scope: owned end-to-end rollout across two teams, mentored 3 engineers
- Examples: PRs #1234, #1278; incident postmortem contribution; peer note from @devin
```
Alex (People Ops): also attach the performance summary and the new role profile. if compensation request deviates from band guidance, add rationale and approval chain.
Jen (Finance): payroll mechanics: cutoff is Wed 23:59 PT before the pay run. we need completed paperwork + GL code to create the journal entry. for retro pay we submit an off-cycle adjustment if missed — that's a manual payroll run and may take an extra pay period.
Sam (Eng Manager): is there an escalation if manager misses the cutoff but it's business critical?
Maya (People Ops): yes — escalate to People Ops lead with subject 'urgent comp request' and include business justification + product impact. we triage and can sometimes do an exception but it's not guaranteed (depends on fiscal approval and payroll bandwidth). :warning:
PayrollBot: Reminder — payroll cutoff upcoming: 2026-03-25 23:59 PT :calendar:
Rachel (SWE II): thanks! saving the checklist. :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): if anyone wants the one-pager checklist I'll drop it in #people-ops-resources in a bit. ping me if you need help prepping the evidence pack.
